claims.claim_text: 2026 年 7 月 3 日，阿爾巴尼亞 .al 這個 TLD 的 DNSSEC key rollover 操作失手，root 的 DS 還指著舊金鑰、權威卻只發新金鑰，整條信任鏈斷裂讓全網驗證失敗。
claims.evidence: On July 3, 2026, the Albanian communications authority (AKEP)... attempted a DNSSEC key rollover. ... the .al operator published a new DNSKEY and stopped serving the old one. The DS record in the root zone still pointed to the old DNSKEY (id=26319), so any resolver attempting to validate .al responses found no matching key and failed.
claims.note: Date, DS-points-to-old-key, and network-wide validation failure all match the source.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 約三小時後部署 Negative Trust Anchor（RFC 7646）恢復連線，代價是暫時放棄該區的密碼學驗證。
claims.evidence: We applied the NTA for .al and rolled it out to all 1.1.1.1 users by 17:15 UTC, roughly three hours after the chain broke. ... a Negative Trust Anchor suspends DNSSEC validation, which means .al domains were no longer protected against DNS spoofing for the duration.
claims.note: ~3 hours, NTA/RFC 7646, and the tradeoff of suspended validation all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 1.1.1.1 現在用 Extended DNS Error 33 明講「這筆回應是在 NTA 下未驗證的」，配合 EDE 9 讓你分得出可信與不可信的答案。
claims.evidence: EDE 33 (Negative Trust Anchor): 'a Negative Trust Anchor has been applied for this query (see RFC 7646)' ... EDE 9 (DNSKEY Missing): 'no SEP matching the DS found for al.'
claims.note: EDE 33 (NTA) and EDE 9 usage confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 一篇長文主張 null-terminated 字串是 1970 年代記憶體限制留下的錯誤，如今該換成「指標 + 長度」的表示法。
claims.evidence: Treating strings as pointers to character 'streams' and relying on a terminating NULL character may have made more sense in the 1970s due to the memory and performance constraints of the time, but nowadays there's basically no reason to keep using it. ... length-based strings—basically, a struct with a pointer and a size.
claims.note: 1970s-constraint thesis and pointer+length replacement match the source.

claims.claim_text: length-based 字串最大的好處——子字串可以 zero-copy，對 parser 與 lexer 影響最深。
claims.evidence: can simply return a new string that references a portion of the original string, avoiding allocations, copies, and any extra memory management [benefiting] lexers and parsers most significantly.
claims.note: Zero-copy substring as primary benefit and lexer/parser impact supported.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 推出 Precursor，用 session 層級持續累積的客戶端互動訊號來辨識自動化 agent，而不是靠單次挑戰。
claims.evidence: Precursor is a client-side, session-based verification system... that uses dynamically injected JavaScript to continuously collect behavioral signals as visitors interact with your application. ... By evaluating behavior across an entire session, Precursor adds significantly more signal to each decision.
claims.note: Session-level continuous signals contrasted against one-off Challenges — matches source.

claims.claim_text: 官方宣稱能在提高 bot 判定準確度的同時，降低對真人使用者的摩擦。
claims.evidence: identifies advanced automation with higher precision — while reducing friction for legitimate users. ... This improves detection precision... For legitimate users, Precursor means fewer unnecessary interruptions.
claims.note: Claim correctly attributed to Cloudflare's own framing (官方宣稱); no hedge inflation.

claims.claim_text: Cursor 在 Windows 上會優先執行 repository 根目錄裡的 git.exe，只要打開帶有惡意 git.exe 的專案，就會無提示、無對話框地任意執行程式碼。
claims.evidence: if that repository contains a malicious git.exe in the project root, Cursor will execute it automatically. ... There are no clicks, prompts, approval dialogs, or warnings. The result is arbitrary code execution.
claims.note: Repo-root git.exe auto-execution with no prompt confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 回報六個月被判為 out-of-scope、CISO 把人導去 HackerOne 後仍未修，研究者最後只能走全面揭露。
claims.note: The source says 'After seven months and no vendor engagement' (reported 2025-12-15, full disclosure 2026-07-14 ≈ 7 months), not six. Also the out-of-scope determination was reversed the SAME day (closed as Informative/out-of-scope on 2026-01-16, then 'Report reopened after successful reproduction' the same day), so the lede's framing of a six-month out-of-scope period is not supported. Number and framing both diverge from source.

claims.claim_text: 釋出開源權重模型 Inkling，975B 總參數、41B 活躍的 Mixture-of-Experts，1M token 上下文，支援文字、影像、音訊多模態輸入，並透過 Tinker 平台開放微調。
claims.evidence: 975B total, 41B active Parameters ... Mixture of Experts Architecture ... 1M tokens Context window ... Text, Image, Audio Input modalities ... Fine-tune Inkling for your domain on Tinker, our training platform. ... Open weights, ready to tinker.
claims.note: All specs (975B/41B, MoE, 1M ctx, text/image/audio, Tinker, open weights) confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 官方發表頁只給了能力雷達圖、沒有具體 benchmark 數字，真正的實力還得等社群跑分。
claims.evidence: The page displays 'a well-rounded, generalist model' evaluated via a spider chart... The chart itself contains no numerical benchmark scores visible in text form—only a visual comparison graphic.
claims.note: Radar/spider chart present, no concrete benchmark numbers — matches source.

claims.claim_text: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines Lab 釋出開源權重模型 Inkling
claims.note: The cited page attributes the release to 'Thinking Machines Lab' but makes no mention of Mira Murati. The 'Mira Murati 的' attribution is not supported by the cited source (not verified against outside knowledge per brief). Low load — a descriptor, not the news.

claims.claim_text: 有人只用一台 13 年前的 Xeon 伺服器、完全不靠 GPU，把 Gemma 4 26B 的推論推到每秒約 5 token。
claims.evidence: it runs Google's Gemma 4, a 26-billion-parameter open-weights mixture-of-experts model, at about five tokens per second. ... a repurposed HP StoreVirtual storage box, roughly thirteen years old, two Ivy Bridge Xeons, no GPU. ... Decode ~5.2 tokens/sec.
claims.note: ~5 tok/s, ~13-year-old Xeon, no GPU all confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: FreeBSD 16 把 base system 裡最後殘留的 GPL 授權程式碼全部汰除
claims.evidence: As of this past week in the FreeBSD source tree for FreeBSD 16, the last of the GNU GPL licensed code from the base system has been retired. [dialog was] the last piece of GNU GPL licensed software in FreeBSD's base system.
claims.note: Last GPL code removed from FreeBSD 16 base system — confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 完成多年推動的授權淨化
claims.note: The Phoronix source does not describe this as completing a 'multi-year' (多年) effort; it notes the removal ticket was 'opened back in February' and a prior installer transition to bsddialog. The '多年推動' framing is not in the cited source. Low load.

claims.claim_text: Mozilla 研究整理了微軟在 Windows 與 Edge 上，如何用設計暗示與流程摩擦持續拖住使用者更換預設瀏覽器。這是先前那份報告的續集。
claims.evidence: Two years ago, Mozilla published Over the Edge: How Microsoft's Design Tactics Compromise Free Browser Choice... Today, we are publishing an updated investigation by the same researchers. ... Microsoft continues to deploy a range of harmful patterns — Trick Wording, Obstruction, Visual Interference, Preselection, Nagging, and Forced Action — at almost every step of the user journey.
claims.note: Sequel status and design-friction documentation confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 並量化了這些手段對瀏覽器競爭的實際影響。
claims.note: Directly contradicted by the source: 'The report does not quantify actual market impact or competitive effects... rather than measuring their measurable effect on browser market share or user behavior outcomes.' The lede asserts the report quantified competitive impact, which the source explicitly disclaims.

claims.claim_text: AWS 開源了 ExtendDB，一個 DynamoDB 相容、儲存後端可插拔的 adapter，主要瞄準開發與測試場景。
claims.evidence: Today, we are announcing ExtendDB, an open source Amazon DynamoDB-compatible adapter with pluggable storage backends, released under the Apache 2.0 License. ... 看得出來主要是補開發與測試時的介面，而不是搞一個 production-ready and self-hosted 版本。
claims.note: Aggregator (gslin) source. Open-source, DynamoDB-compatible, pluggable backends, and dev/test focus all confirmed in the gslin post text.

claims.claim_text: Netflix 釋出影像品質評估演算法 VMAF v1，在刻意維持與 v0 分數相容的前提下，改善對壓縮影像品質的判斷準確度。
claims.evidence: VMAF v1's score and interpretation are largely consistent with v0's. To achieve this, we calibrated the VMAF v1 scale to align with v0 via a score transform, so that the new algorithm preserves the meaning of the numbers while keeping its accuracy benefits.
claims.note: Aggregator (gslin) source. Deliberate v0 score compatibility plus accuracy improvement both confirmed.
